g.text: From root words to the spherical enhanced category
Finite supports and frame bounds; arithmetic trait; finite E/Qℓ.
1. The actual flag basis retains its unit summand
Ind Res P ≃ ⊕j P(−aj)[−2aj]
b1 = 1; a1 = 0: P → Ind Res P → P
The composite is id P, with a coherent splitting.
Constant flag ↪ longest-wall image ↠ constant flag.
Induced root words retract from concatenated wall words.
Keep the compensating shift [−dim F]; C.27.1.1.
2. Every coordinate coefficient and every nerve level
φ(t) = zt + b2t² + ⋯ + bm−1tᵐ⁻¹
z invertible; underlying Autm = Gm × Aᵐ⁻²
Q = loop jets ⋊ Autm; retain all Qᵠ ×S X.
Product root envelopes compare the actual level maps.
Then derived totalization; C.27.2.1–C.27.2.2.
3. Ordered convolution uses the original kernel
CQ(A) = Rm*(p*A ⊗L KQ)
CQ(Bword) = translate · Θs1⋯Θsr(Q)[r]
Each unshifted wall adds one word and shift [−1].
Finite cones and coherent retracts preserve closure.
Actual frames retain associativity and units; C.27.3.1.
The flag projection is linear, not multiplicative.
Ordered monoidal comparison; full coordinate action retained.
Moving fusion still determines the symmetric interchange.
